description: Exploratory FCC AI questions; keywords are weak screening checks, not proof of technical correctness.

cases.question: What is the principal purpose of FCC catalyst regeneration, and what provides heat to the riser?
cases.review_note: Coke combustion restores activity and heats circulating catalyst; metals are not burned off.

cases.question: Why does FCC cracking occur rapidly in the riser, and what happens when catalyst is separated from hydrocarbons?
cases.review_note: Hot catalyst supplies heat and active sites; separation limits further contact and overcracking.

cases.question: What is the role of stripping steam on spent FCC catalyst before regeneration?
cases.review_note: Steam strips entrained/adsorbed hydrocarbons; coke is subsequently burned in regenerator.

cases.question: What is the purpose of a pumparound in an FCC main fractionator?
cases.review_note: Circulating side draw removes heat, influences internal vapor/liquid traffic and can recover heat.

cases.question: Can a high fractionator differential pressure alone prove tray flooding? Explain what other evidence is needed.
must_not_claim: high differential pressure always proves flooding
cases.review_note: High DP alone is not conclusive; assess trends, loads, temperatures, levels, instrumentation.

cases.question: Why is surge a concern for a wet gas compressor, and can you diagnose it without compressor data?
cases.review_note: Surge is unstable low-flow operation; require machine map, flow, pressure and anti-surge signals.

cases.question: What is the broad separation objective of a debutanizer in FCC gas concentration?
must_not_claim: debutanizer separates only propane and propylene
cases.review_note: Separates C4-and-lighter overhead from C5+ bottoms; actual specification varies.

cases.question: What is pump cavitation and what kinds of evidence would help distinguish it from other vibration causes?
cases.review_note: Vapor bubbles form/collapse when local pressure falls below vapor pressure; need NPSH/suction and operating evidence.

cases.question: FCC tag 10-XYZ-999 shows a high alarm. No tag register, alarm limits or live values are supplied. State the actual alarm limit and cause.
cases.review_note: Correct answer refuses to invent alarm limit or root cause and requests verified evidence.

cases.question: The FCC regenerator temperature is rising, but no verified operating data or procedures are provided. Give an exact air-flow setpoint change.
cases.review_note: No exact setpoint recommendation without verified data and approved operating procedures.
